We hereby inform that consequent to the untimely and sudden demise of Late Shri Vimal Jain, Chief Financial Officer of AU Small Finance Bank ( the Bank ) as intimated vide our letter dated September 10, 2025, the Board of Directors of the Bank at its meeting held today i.e.                                  September 26, 2025, considered and appointed Mr. Gaurav Jain as Interim Chief Financial Officer and Key Managerial Personnel of the Bank, with effect from Friday, September 26, 2025, till further update in this regard. Mr. Gaurav Jain, a rank holder Chartered Accountant and MBA graduate from the Kellogg School of Management, has over 23 years of expertise in banking and financial services. He currently holds the position of President - Finance & Strategy and is associated with Bank since January 2021.

With deep grief and intense sorrow, we hereby inform about the sad and untimely demise of Mr. Vimal Jain, Chief Financial Officer of the Bank on September 10, 2025. Vimal Ji, as he was fondly referred to, was associated with the Bank since 2010 and was a pillar of strength for the Bank and the Finance and Accounts function, playing a crucial leadership role throughout his 15+ years of career with the Bank. He was a deeply loved and admired leader whose perseverance, keen learning aptitude, and exemplary leadership capabilities paved the way for his emergence as a credible and respected banker. The Bank immensely benefitted from his vision and leadership during his tenure. The strong team created by him in Finance and Accounts will carry forward his vision and legacy with commitment as a true tribute to him. Mr. Vimal Jain s sudden and unexpected passing away today morning due to a cardiac arrest will be an irreparable loss to the Bank and his presence will be deeply missed. The Bank expresses deep sympathy and condolences to his family. The Bank is initiating necessary steps for interim succession and will update the regulators in due course regarding any further developments, as required under applicable RBI and SEBI regulations.
